residualRisks: The test harness runs in a partial DOM/Canvas environment without a real browser; canvas pixel operations use the harness shim which records calls but does not render. The `isCanvasBlank()` and `countNonTransparent()` functions check alpha values of recorded ImageData, providing some functional verification.

The eraser test (eraser) only verifies that the button exists and toggles its active state via [data-tool] attribute; it does not verify that selecting eraser mode actually causes pixels to become transparent when drawing.
The palette_brush test checks swatch count >= 8 and that one swatch becomes active, but does not verify that the selected color is actually used for pixel drawing.
The undo_redo test verifies history display text changes (structural) but does not verify that undo/redo operations restore actual canvas pixel state to the correct previous values.
Mouse touch handlers are verified by source-text regex in the check; this confirms registration at parse time, not runtime binding.
The test environment uses constantRandom mode for deterministic results; real-browser behavior with timing-sensitive pointer events may differ.
